product.olivetti-philos-48.summary: The Philos 48 from the range expansion announced at CeBIT 1994.
product.olivetti-philos-48.history: Olivetti expanded its business notebook range with the Philos 45, 46 and 48 at CeBIT 1994. MCmicrocomputer identifies the 48 among the new models.
product.olivetti-philos-48.architecture: The processor distinguishes this configuration in the CeBIT announcement. MCmicrocomputer identifies it as IntelDX4 · 75 MHz.
product.olivetti-philos-48.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-48.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
